definitions.gloss: the way home; return journey; homeward path
definitions.explanation: The route or journey back to one's home or starting point. A somewhat formal or literary word often used in written narratives and news.

examples.japanese: {帰路|きろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧。
examples.english: It started raining on the way home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}えて→終える：02019_oeru⟧{帰路|きろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ついたとき、⟦ほっとした→ほっとする：07652_hottosuru⟧。
examples.english: I felt relieved when I finally headed home after a long business trip.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat formal word. The set phrase {帰路|きろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つく (to set out for home, to head home) is the most common usage. Often appears in written narratives, travel writing, and news reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {帰路|きろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つく (to head home)
- {帰路|きろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧ (on the way home)
- {帰路|きろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{急|いそ}ぐ→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧ (to hurry home)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{帰|かえ}り{道|みち}→帰り道：12447_kaerimichi⟧: the way home — everyday, casual equivalent
- ⟦{復路|ふくろ}→復路：20538_fukuro⟧: return trip — more formal, used for round-trip travel
